instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging program. Fuel cost is primarily pass-through under capacity purchase agreements with major airline partners (United, Delta, American, Alaska and others). SKYW bears fuel risk only on pro-rate operations.

warnings: Fuel cost is primarily pass-through to major airline partners under capacity purchase agreements. United bears fuel risk for United Express; Delta bears fuel risk for Delta Connection RJ flights. Some turboprop/Continental routes where SKYW bears fuel risk. No hedging program.

throughput.source_quote: Estimated: fuel expense $252,556K / $1.45 per gallon = ~174.2M gallons. Item 7: 'average price of fuel increasing to $1.45 per gallon during the year ended December 31, 2004, from $1.12 per gallon.'
